statusCode.description: The HTTP status code returned by the error.

service.description: Codat's service the returned the error.

error.description: A brief description of the error.

correlationId.description: Unique identifier used to propagate to all downstream services and determine the source of the error.

canBeRetried.description: `True` if the error occurred transiently and can be retried.

detailedErrorCode.description: Machine readable error code used to automate processes based on the code returned.

errorValidation.title: Validation error
errorValidation.description: A human-readable object describing validation decisions Codat has made. If an operation has failed because of validation errors, they will be detailed here.

itemId.description: Unique identifier for a validation item.

message.description: A message outlining validation item's issue.
